title: How To Swap Tokens/NFTs
summary: Learn how to Swap Tokens/NFTs with DropChain
body:
How to Swap Tokens/NFTs with DropChain

DropChain makes building web3 apps easy — no web3 development expertise needed. If you haven't created an account on DropChain yet, please follow the DropChain Getting Started guide.

‍

Swapping Tokens/NFTs with the DropChain API

Swapping tokens or NFTs with atomic_swap means exchanging one asset for another between two users. This can be useful for trading items, exchanging tokens for services, or facilitating transactions within a marketplace.

You might want to use this API endpoint to trade a game item with another player for a different item, exchange tokens for access to a premium feature or service within an application, or facilitate transactions within a marketplace.

The DropChain API is available in both code and no-code forms. So, regardless of your technical expertise, you can build a web3 app in no time!

‍
